## 🔍 Tool: search_internal_content
Query di-embed dengan **bge-m3**, lalu dicari dengan **cosine similarity** di pgvector. Mendukung filter website via parameter `site` (slug/domain).

parameters.query:
SELECT c.text,
       c.metadata->>'url'     AS url,
       c.metadata->>'title'   AS title,
       c.metadata->>'section' AS section,
       1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS score,
       p.outline, p.word_count
FROM seo_chunks c
LEFT JOIN seo_pages p ON p.url = c.metadata->>'url'
WHERE ($3 = '' OR c.site_slug = $3 OR c.metadata->>'url' ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%')
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT $2::int;
